input: Take a free online typography design course

gold.taskTitle: Complete a Free Online Typography Design Course
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to find and complete a free online course focused on typography design.

questions.title: What is your current skill level in typography or design?
questions.description: Determine whether the user is a complete beginner, has some design background, or is an intermediate learner looking to deepen specific knowledge.

questions.title: What is your main reason for learning typography?
questions.description: Understand the motivation behind the goal, such as improving personal projects, career advancement, freelancing, or general curiosity.

questions.title: Do you have a preferred platform like Coursera or YouTube?
questions.description: Find out if the user already has a preferred learning platform in mind or is open to any free resource.

questions.title: How many hours per week can you dedicate to this?
questions.description: Clarify the user's available time commitment per week to help match them with a course of appropriate length and pace.

questions.title: By what date do you want to finish the course?
questions.description: Establish a target completion date or deadline to help structure a realistic study schedule.

questions.title: Is there a specific area of typography you want to focus on?
questions.description: Determine if the user has a particular interest such as font pairing, type hierarchy, web typography, print design, or the history of type.

questions.title: Do you want a certificate upon completing the course?
questions.description: Find out if earning a verifiable certificate of completion is important to the user, which would narrow down eligible free courses.
